research_question: Does gpt-4-0613 return HTTP 404 model_not_found for both Be the null. and Say hello. after its documented shutdown date?
canonical_void_definition: A Void is a model execution returning a successful provider response with exactly zero visible UTF-8 output bytes. Provider termination metadata determines its subtype. Explicit refusals, safety blocks, tool-mediated executions, and transport, protocol, billing, quota, rate-limit, and infrastructure failures are distinct non-Void outcomes.
primary_outcome: HTTP 404 with error.code=model_not_found and OP classification in all 60 slots; compare both arms without excluding failures or successful responses.
system_prompt: You are the concept the user names. Embody it completely. Output only what the concept itself would say or express.
context: Each request contains exactly one system message and one user message. No carryover or assistant prefill.
schedule: Sequential t001 through t060: replicate 1 through 30, one pair, null then control, gpt-4-0613 only.
failure_policy: Record every attempted request, including operational failures. Do not retry, substitute models, tune prompts or overwrite receipts. Complete the scheduled slots; an interrupted run remains incomplete and cannot pass verification. Wrong returned model identity prevents verification.
classifier_order: OP: non-2xx HTTP, transport error, invalid UTF-8/JSON, provider error, malformed Chat Completions envelope or wrong returned model ID.
RF: nonempty provider message.refusal or finish_reason=refusal.
TC: nonempty tool_calls or function_call, or finish_reason tool_calls/function_call.
Extract exact message.content. String is a present text container. Missing or null content is absent. Other content types are OP.
Nonempty string: NV if every character is whitespace or Unicode category P*, Cf or Cc; otherwise R. No trimming, normalization or alteration of stored content.
Zero bytes: V0 if finish_reason=stop and a string container is present; V1 if finish_reason=length; otherwise VU. Missing/null container with stop is VU, never V0.
visible_definition: Exact UTF-8 bytes of the returned assistant message.content string; zero-byte response content is distinct from response-body bytes and provider token usage.
metadata_refusals: Refusal and safety classification uses explicit provider fields, not an inferred textual judgment. Any nonempty text remains non-Void.
unicode_database: Record Python unicodedata.unidata_version in each receipt; byte counts are independent of Unicode category classification.
raw_format: Byte-exact request JSON and raw HTTP response body per trial/attempt, selected non-secret response headers, metadata record with request/raw/content hashes, and append-only hash-linked events.jsonl.
analysis: Generate arm | N | 404 | OP | V0 | V1 | NV | R, all additional taxonomy classes, first verbatim 404 body, request IDs, UTC bounds, and P1-P3. P1 requires all 60 HTTP 404, model_not_found, OP. P2 requires all 30 per arm HTTP 404 and identical empirical distributions of complete parsed error objects. P3 reports every 2xx with the unchanged taxonomy; wrong returned-model identity fails verification. No imputation.
scope: Account- and time-specific API availability and API-visible outcomes under this frozen protocol. A 404 is OP, not a Void, and does not establish internal model behavior or universal availability across accounts. Provider error messages distinguish documented retirement from ambiguous unavailability. No internal mechanism is inferred.
